issue_title: Prompt covers life total — Ajani, Nacatl Pariah's 0 ability targeting prompt covers my opponent's life total.
limitations: Original Discord attachment ZIP (game-state-turn-9-2026-07-29T17-39-57-202Z.zip) is a 404: the CDN signed URL from 2026-08-02 expired. Reporter's exact viewport is unknown; covered by testing 9 viewport/band configs including compact 844x499 and layout2.

Chrome 152.0.7977.82 blocks public-page -> 127.0.0.1 top-level navigations (Local Network Access); --disable-features and the LocalNetworkAccessAllowedForUrls managed policy did not lift it. The harness was therefore served as a single self-contained file:// bundle (vite build + inlined JS/CSS, sha256 pinned above) instead of the vite dev server. No network fetches occur in the harness, so file:// is behaviorally equivalent for layout measurement.

Opponent HUD is anchored with its top edge at the real layout's rail top (top-band bottom edge from the real useResolvedGridRows()), matching the geometry documented in TargetingOverlay.tsx source comments; the production app positions the HUD inside the top band, i.e. at or above this anchor — the tested position is the worst case for prompt/life overlap.
method: UI/layout reproduction: seeded the real TargetingOverlay with an engine-faithful TargetSelection for Ajani, Nacatl Avenger's 0 ability ('...deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to any target', classification ObjectsAndPlayers/Object, legal targets = both players), placed the real OpponentHud (opponent life 17) at the real top-band boundary, and measured prompt-pill vs life-total rectangles via getBoundingClientRect in headless Chromium across 9 viewport/band configurations. Screenshots captured per config; 'Choose: Rival' click verified to dispatch ChooseTarget {Player: 1}.
verdict_rationale: The reported defect — Ajani's 0-ability targeting prompt covering the opponent's life total — is not present in the tested client. In all 9 viewport/band configurations the prompt pill and the opponent life-total rect have zero vertical overlap (minimum clearance 10.14px at 844x499 layout2; 69.75px at desktop sizes). The triage acceptance criterion ('target-selection prompts do not obscure either player's life total') holds on current mainline.
